## Streyn 1.15.0

- **Chillscreen:** the record only changes when the song really changes, and the whole change runs first (old record back in its sleeve, new one out, needle down) before the new song is shown. The room is decorated with your queue: crate, CDs, shelf, wall and prints show the covers of the songs that come next
- **Add to playlist:** a plus button on every song (also songs from Spotify and in imported playlists) lists all your playlists, imported ones included, plus Liked songs and a new playlist. Songs from other platforms can now be added too
- **Edit mode:** a pencil button on playlists and imported playlists opens an edit view (full screen on the phone): drag songs by the handle to reorder, remove them with minus, edit name and cover
- **Profile bio:** write a few words about yourself in Edit profile, shown in the profile panel
- **Preload that really works:** the preload button and the next song in the queue now put the whole song on the server's disk, so it plays at once without loading (up to 3 GB, oldest songs go first)
- **Player bar:** active buttons (queue, lyrics, visualizer, shuffle, repeat) light up in the accent colour with a small dot like Spotify. The mini visualizer is back as a thin, smooth strip along the bottom edge of the bar (Settings → Visualizer). Same space above and below everything in the bar
- **Big player:** click the song name or cover in the bar on the computer; on the phone a tap anywhere on the small player opens it
- **Heart:** a clean outline heart like Spotify
- **Settings on small phones:** nothing wider than the screen any more, controls move under their text
- **Light mode:** light search bar, clean mini player card, readable button hover, light back button
- **Liquid Glass:** the sidebar, dialogs, profile panel and device sheet are real refracting glass too, the profile panel and device sheet are clear instead of frosted

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
